meta.title: Featured Plugins
meta.description: Discover, filter and install featured DSH plugins in one place: search, tag filters, one-click install and README previews.

searchPlaceholder: Search plugins by name, description or tag…
applyStep1: Fork the skillpie/dsh-plugins repo and add your plugin to entries in the root plugins.json, following the existing entry format (package, title, description, version, tags…).
applyStep2: Open a Pull Request. Once merged, your plugin appears in every client that integrates Featured Plugins, with version and icon resolved automatically.
applyStep3: You can also file an Issue with the package name and a short description, and a maintainer will add it for you.
empty: No featured entries yet: submit a listing on GitHub
welcome: The full Featured plugin (dsh-featured) is not installed.
installed: Installed — refresh to use the full experience.
desc: Browse the community's featured plugins from one tab: search, tag filters, one-click install and README previews.
